Name: Laban
Summary: Laban was the brother of Rebekah and the son of Bethuel. He later became Jacob's father-in-law, and his dealings with Jacob fill a whole chapter of the patriarchs' story.
KeyStory: Laban welcomed Abraham's servant, negotiated Rebekah's marriage to Isaac, and years later outwitted Jacob over wages and wives — until Jacob finally left for home.
RelatedPeople: Rebekah; Bethuel; Jacob; Leah; Rachel; Bilhah; Zilpah
LifeLesson: Cleverness without honesty eventually drives away the very people it tries to keep.
